label: Вперёд
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вперёд (forward, ahead).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Forward motion. 'Вперёд' means forward and modifies the imperative 'сделай', marking the direction of the step. It shows real movement toward the front.
Strategic focus: Moving ahead. 'Вперёд' modifies 'двинулась' to show the car starting forward. The adverb fixes the direction of travel as toward the front.

missions.phrase: Смело иди вперёд к своей цели.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Striving forward. 'Вперёд' modifies 'иди' both literally and figuratively, marking progress toward a goal. With 'к своей цели' it blends physical and motivational direction.
Strategic focus: Surging ahead. 'Вперёд' modifies 'рванулись' to mark the runners' burst toward the front. The adverb gives the direction of the sudden forward dash.
Strategic focus: Leaning forward. 'Вперёд' modifies the imperative 'наклонись' to mark the body tilting toward the front. The adverb gives the precise direction of the lean.

missions.phrase: Часы спешат на пять минут вперёд.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Running fast on a clock. 'Вперёд' modifies 'спешат' in the idiom for a clock being ahead. Here the forward direction is applied to time rather than space.
Strategic focus: Forward versus backward. 'Вперёд' modifies 'смотри' to mark looking ahead, set against 'назад'. The pair captures the contrast between past and future orientation.
Strategic focus: Sailing onward. 'Вперёд' modifies 'плыл' to mark the ship's forward progress through the water. The adverb keeps the direction toward the front.
Strategic focus: Letting someone ahead. 'Вперёд' modifies 'пропусти' to mean letting the speaker move to the front. The directional adverb marks the desired forward position.
Strategic focus: Advancing as a group. 'Вперёд' modifies 'идёт' to mark the team's forward progress. The adverb carries both literal motion and a sense of momentum toward success.
